s0201.literal: Budashiri was originally my uncle's wife; she secretly plotted with treacherous ministers, did not respect my intent, presumptuously assumed the title Grand Empress Dowager; tracing the disasters within her inner chambers, she sundered flesh-and-blood kin — her crimes were especially grave; measured against great righteousness, her lofty title was stripped away and she was relocated to reside at Dong'an Prefecture.
s0201.idiomatic: Budashiri, my uncle's wife, secretly colluded with treacherous ministers, showed no regard for my wishes, and arrogantly assumed the title of Grand Empress Dowager. The scandal within her household sundered the imperial kin; her crimes were grave beyond measure. By the standards of righteousness, her exalted titles are revoked and she is banished to Dong'an Prefecture.

s0202.literal: Yan Tiegusi was sent away to Goryeo; before he arrived, Yuekuochai killed him on the road.
s0202.idiomatic: Yan Tiegusi was exiled to Goryeo; before he arrived, Yuekuochai killed him en route.
